destination.name: Mount Putuo
destination.tagline: A small sacred island of Guanyin temples, bronze statues and sandy beaches
destination.description: Mount Putuo is a small island in the Zhoushan archipelago and one of the four sacred Buddhist mountains of China, dedicated to the bodhisattva Guanyin. Its three major temples include Puji, the largest, and Fayu. A 33 m bronze Guanyin overlooks the sea. Foding Mountain rises to sea views and Huiji Temple, and Hundred Step Beach lies on the coast.
whyVisit: Climb Foding Mountain for sea views
Walk sandy beaches on the coast

goodToKnow.title: Reached by ferry
goodToKnow.detail: The island is reached by fast ferry from Shenjiamen or Zhujiajian, so check the last sailing back. Bring ID for tickets.

goodToKnow.title: Cable car up Foding
goodToKnow.detail: Foding Mountain can be climbed by stone steps or taken by cable car if your legs are tired.

goodToKnow.title: Weather can delay boats
goodToKnow.detail: Fog or typhoons can disrupt ferries, so keep a spare day if your schedule is tight.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} suit temple walks in mild weather. The island is small and can be crowded.
